description: Opens folders from \\wsl.localhost or \\wsl$ straight in a WSL window, so you don't have to click "Reopen Folder in WSL".
config.enabled: Automatically reopen folders opened through a WSL network path (`\\wsl.localhost\...` or `\\wsl$\...`) in a WSL window. Set to `false` in a folder's `.vscode/settings.json` to keep that folder in a Windows window.
config.exclude: WSL folders and workspace files that stay in a Windows window, as `\\wsl.localhost\<distro>\<path>` (or `\\wsl$\...`). An entry also covers everything inside it. **WSL Auto Reopen: Reopen Folder in Windows and Keep It There** adds entries here when you pick **Only for me**.
command.reopenInWindows: Reopen Folder in Windows and Keep It There
